column1: # Tetris Effect: Connected: Monstars and Resonair (published by Enhance), Unreal Engine 4.26 / 4.27 with IoStore containers (.utoc / .ucas), Wwise, SDK 13.3.2,
# NVN, nn::movie for the backgrounds' .mp4 movies; update 2.0.2.2 (v1310720).
# PEANUTS: started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) on a Windows PC; shader_groups set by hand (below). Runs on an AYN Thor
# on Turnip with patches.py's RedpointEOS cut; the memory values are the Unreal guess, not measured (README.md)

# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. The rewriter cuts the allocator in any Unreal 4 / 5 main (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), so an iPhone takes a smaller guest block, as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/reference/memory.md)
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# the shaders are inline in the cooked packages (no shader code archives): the engine's global shader cache in the .pak, the engine's and the game's materials in the IoStore container
